title: Hired Since 2020
description:
Report the `name` and `hire_date` of everyone hired on or after 1 January 2020.

Name the columns `name` and `hire_date`. Return the result in any order.
schemaSql:
CREATE TABLE departments (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  name TEXT,
  location TEXT
);

CREATE TABLE employees (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  name TEXT,
  title TEXT,
  salary INTEGER,
  dept_id INTEGER,
  manager_id INTEGER,
  hire_date TEXT
);
solutionSql: SELECT name, hire_date FROM employees WHERE hire_date >= '2020-01-01';
hint: ISO dates (YYYY-MM-DD) compare correctly as plain strings — no date function needed.
outputExplanation: Dan, Finn, Gia and Hal were hired on or after January 1, 2020. Ava, Ben, Cara and Eve were hired earlier.
